intent: Bind one current Necessary Context Basis to a consumer-specific Context Window View without weakening identity, provenance, or residue.

required_conditions: the basis digest and consumer are explicit
identity lane is exactly plan-bound or interaction-bound
unchanged plan-bound reuse carries a per-turn reuse receipt
every interaction-bound human or chat turn creates an immutable successor view
selected dependency change creates a successor view
projection exclusions and residue remain digest bound
